summary: "Not What He Seems" is the eleventh episode of the second season of the animated series "Gravity Falls", created by Alex Hirsch and directed by Stephen Sandoval. The series follows twins Dipper and Mabel Pines, who spend the summer with their great uncle Grunkle Stan at the Mystery Shack in Gravity Falls, Oregon. In this episode, the twins begin to question who Stan really is after he is arrested for stealing chemical waste. The episode breaks the show's status quo by introducing Stan's long-lost twin brother and ends with a cliffhanger leading into the second half of the season.
one_line: Season two episode of the animated series "Gravity Falls" in which Dipper and Mabel question Grunkle Stan's identity after his arrest.
key_facts: "Not What He Seems" is the eleventh episode of the second season of the American animated television series "Gravity Falls".
"Gravity Falls" was created by Alex Hirsch.
The episode was written by Shion Takeuchi, Josh Weinstein, Jeff Rowe, Matt Chapman, and Alex Hirsch.
The episode was directed by Stephen Sandoval.
The series follows twelve-year-old twins Dipper Pines and Mabel Pines.
Dipper is voiced by Jason Ritter and Mabel is voiced by Kristen Schaal.
Dipper and Mabel stay for the summer with their great uncle Grunkle Stan, voiced by Alex Hirsch, at the Mystery Shack.
The Mystery Shack is a tourist trap set within the fictional town of Gravity Falls, Oregon.
In the episode, Dipper and Mabel begin to question who Stan really is after officers arrest him for stealing chemical waste.
The episode breaks the show's status quo by introducing Stan's long-lost twin brother.
The episode ends with a cliffhanger to the second half of the season.
